nodes.title: T2VA PROMPT FORMAT
widgets_values:
T2VA PROMPT FORMAT

T2VA begins directly with these three fields in this exact order—there is no Picture alignment instruction:

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Describe visible style, composition, subjects, actions, camera movement, dialogue, and synchronized diegetic events.

overall_soundscape: Summarize ambience, physical sounds, and non-verbal human sounds.

non_diegetic_music: Describe audience-only music, or use N/A.

For a chained continuation, explicitly continue the incoming pose, action phase, camera position and motion, lighting, environment, object states, ambience, and speaker identity. Do not re-establish or reset the shot unless a cut is intentional.

nodes.title: CURRENT T2V SCENE — PROMPT / SEED / TIMING
CORE T2VA — NO IMAGE INPUTS
widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description: The target video is in a hyper-realistic, cinematic single-take confessional style, shallow depth of field, soft moody key light on one side of the face, dark neutral background, portrait orientation.
[Shot 1] A tight portrait shot frames a weary 40-year-old man seated close to camera, stubble catching the light, eyes glistening as he stares just past the lens. His breath catches once before he speaks. The raw, trembling-voiced man (S1) says, <d>[English] I have to be honest with you. I left Wan. It wasn't working anymore — the consistency, the way it just... let me down when I needed it most.</d> His hand comes up, rubbing his brow, a bitter half-smile breaking through. [Shot 2] At 00:04.500, he leans in slightly, voice steadying, a flicker of guilty excitement crossing his face. He continues, <d>[English] I'm with MiniMax now. And I know how that sounds. But for the first time in a long time... I feel understood.</d> His eyes well up, lip trembling, before he lets out a short, broken laugh and looks down, shaking his head at himself.

overall_soundscape: A quiet room tone hums beneath, with a single sharp intake of breath before he speaks, a soft rustle as his hand moves to his face, and a faint, choked exhale on the laugh.

non_diegetic_music: A single sustained low piano note holds under the first line, joined by a soft, melancholic string swell, dropping away entirely on the final broken laugh.

nodes.title: TRIM 22 CONTEXT FRAMES / RETAIN 5 FOR BLEND
RECOVERY / ASSEMBLE LATER
widgets_values:
The two amber recovery nodes are MUTED by default.

If all segments finished but final assembly did not, mute the main green Assemble node, enable both recovery nodes, and queue. They validate every SHA-256 checkpoint pair and assemble without rerendering the completed clips.

For an interrupted generation, leave recovery muted and set Loop Start's start_clip to the first unfinished clip.

nodes.title: T2V STUDIO — HOW TO USE
widgets_values:
T2V STUDIO — QUICK START

This workflow keeps the same T2VA prompts, seeds, and sampling graph as the Normal version, but uses the advanced authoring pair: Plan Studio plus the separate Rich Scene Prompt Editor.

Use Plan Studio for timeline navigation, scene prompt revisions, saved-segment status, and preview playback. Use Rich Scene Prompt Editor for decorated references and optional prompt optimization. Both write edits back into the connected Plan; neither replaces ComfyUI execution or changes sampling.

TIMING
Each requested 10-second scene is 243 raw H3 frames. Scene 2 repeats 22 context frames, so delivery is 243 + (243 - 22) = 464 frames = 19.333 seconds at 24 fps.

BLENDING
Plan carries 22 frames of motion context but blends only 5 frames at the visible boundary. This intentionally demonstrates that video_blend_frames is independent from context_length. The final video is re-encoded for the cumulative linear blend; generated audio remains frame-locked and is not crossfaded.
